feature: Horizontal glyph scaling and explicit page breaks
visualReview: All 28 native/Word page pairs reviewed, including intentional blank pages, wrapping, run decorations and split paragraph shading. Initial native golden images use PDFBox at 96 dpi with no masks; no established golden replaced.
widthQualification: Scaled wrapping retains Word line breaks; the longest marker accumulates a measured 0.312-point horizontal difference. Point-based tracking and kerning stay unscaled, avoiding the earlier multi-point errors.
